bullets: New: once a day the tracker asks who is using it, from this workbook's own list. Pick your name or add yourself. It fills in Treating technician and signs the Edit log.
The clinic is never assumed. It comes from Settings or the workbook's name, and once saved only an admin can change it.
New: the bell in the top right lists what changed in the tracker. A note like this one appears once after each update.
Banners you dismiss or snooze stay hidden when you switch between the task pane and full screen.
